# Veritio

> Veritio is a protocol-first, open-source evidence layer for application audit
> events, hash-linked records, evidence graphs, and independently verifiable
> export bundles. Veritio Cloud is a separate optional managed path. Veritio
> supports evidence workflows; it is not legal advice or automatic compliance.

The TypeScript, Python, and Go SDKs share language-neutral event semantics,
canonical JSON, hashing, and deterministic redaction. The OSS path does not
require a hosted account, hosted project, hosted key, or proprietary storage.

- [Reference](https://getveritio.com/docs/reference/event-schema/)

Every documentation page also has a static Markdown representation at the
same path without the trailing slash and with `.md` appended.

## Agent discovery

- [Structured documentation index](https://getveritio.com/agent-index.json)
- [Bounded full documentation corpus](https://getveritio.com/llms-full.txt)

HTML routes are canonical. The Markdown, JSON, and full-text files are generated
from the same verified content for retrieval and citation; their presence does
not guarantee selection, citation, or ranking by any search or agent system.
